verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

[A] Time is lost a little at every stop (Grant Av -> Euclid Av +25s, Nostrand Av -> Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts +45s, Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts -> target +35s): a dwell-time / crowding pattern rather than one bad segment.

9% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'planned_work' alert was active for the line (problem rate 28% with an alert vs 24% without, lift 1.2x).

33% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 93%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at Jay St-MetroTech and the stops before it during the affected hours: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on A, C during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for A, C; use alternates F, FX
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for A, C; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of Jay St-MetroTech; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
recommendations.rationale: ETAs drift substantially before problem arrivals, indicating holds.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer discretionary holds; more accurate countdown clocks.
